# Inter's static Regular TTF, vendored by vendor-inter.py: the UI font a web page draws its text in, since a page opens
# no system font file.
# Nothing is built; shaped-rendering names the file in the link option a page embeds it with.
set(SC_UI_FONT_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Inter-Regular.ttf" CACHE INTERNAL "the vendored UI font a web page embeds")
